metadata.selection_protocol: Within this rerun baseline grids and MGRE alpha use validation only; point predictors and validation-trained scales are frozen before calibration; calibration supplies only the finite-sample conformal quantile. Test and thickness-shift partitions are evaluated after the rerun freeze, but the inherited partitions and their outcomes were inspected on 2026-10-16. Results are exploratory replication, not an untouched confirmatory evaluation or verified FE generalization. Learning curves reuse fixed baseline hyperparameters, their own training subset and validation-only alpha.
metadata.seed_interpretation: Training seeds are 40, 41 and 42 by default; paired bootstrap uses seed 43 on fixed mean-across-seed predictions. Same fixed train/validation/calibration/test groups; seeds measure algorithm sensitivity, not independent experiments. Mean/Ridge/RBF_SVR/HGB are deterministic here, fit once and reused across seeds with identical predictions and zero SD; their reported training duration is the original reference fit. Identical deterministic MGRE global SVR branches are cached by exact training features+labels hash; stochastic gates/experts and MLP/RandomForest are actually fitted for each seed.
metadata.material_role: Assigned illustrative normalization constants only; no material calibration performed.
metadata.retained_auxiliary_fields_role: The workbook clean-reference and noise-scale columns coincide with the prior synthetic benchmark. They are diagnostic-only, not verified physical truth, never model inputs, tuning criteria, or calibration inputs.

model_architecture.name: Mechanics-normalized gated residual ensemble (MGRE)
model_architecture.normalization: StandardScaler fitted on train only, separately for z and gate
model_architecture.gate: 3-component full-covariance GaussianMixture, 2 initializations, reg_covar=1e-4, train features only
model_architecture.expert_objective: HGB squared residual loss with weights max(g_k,0.02), 180 iterations,15 leaves, minleaf25,lr0.055,l2=1
model_architecture.fusion: rhat=alpha*f_global+(1-alpha)*sum_k(g_k*f_k); alpha grid [0,.25,.5,.75,1] minimizes validation MAE in mm; yhat=m*exp(rhat)
model_architecture.uncertainty: For every baseline and point-model ablation, absolute validation errors train HGB(loss=absolute_error,80iter,7leaves,minleaf45,lr.06,l2=2); positive scale=max(predicted_error,.015mm). Calibration q is sorted normalized error at ceil((n_cal+1)*.9), capped at n_cal. Interval=[max(0,yhat-q*scale),yhat+q*scale]. ConstantInterval reuses MGRE point predictions and q from unnormalized errors, scale=1.
model_architecture.NoMechanics: Raw six features, median-training-label constant positive scale; gate uses [h,L,Rp,Rs]. Jointly removes engineered descriptors and mechanics prior; not a single-component descriptor-only test.
model_architecture.NoRatioPredictor: Isolated predictor-descriptor ablation: retains exactly the same mechanics prior and four gate inputs, but changes the global and local predictor input z from 12 descriptors to the raw six inputs. The gate remains normalized and mechanics-informed; own validation alpha is allowed.
model_architecture.NoResidualPrior: Retains all 12 descriptors and the same four dimensionless gate inputs; learns log(y) with m=1, removing only the mechanics residual prior.
model_architecture.NoGate: One globally trained HGB local branch, global SVR branch; own validation-selected alpha.
model_architecture.NoGlobal: Softly gated local experts only, alpha=0.
model_architecture.ConstantInterval: MGRE points unchanged; replaces adaptive error scale by a constant. This tests interval adaptation only, not point performance.

claims_boundary: All conclusions are conditional on this author-supplied, provenance-pending workbook. Its numerical values coincide with the prior synthetic benchmark; native FE origin is unverified. This exploratory replication cannot establish real FE/experimental accuracy, unique optimal stroke, final residual shape, or physical qualification. Auxiliary clean/noise columns are unverified diagnostics only. No superiority is assumed and all negative results are retained.
